description: Fetch a public URL's robots.txt once and evaluate it for specific crawlers (default: every crawler in the directory). Returns allowed/blocked per crawler, whether a matching group exists, the deciding Allow/Disallow rule, crawl-delay, and sitemap pointers. Pass paths to evaluate additional same-origin paths against the same rules (no extra request). Use when the user asks 'can GPTBot read this page?', 'is ClaudeBot blocked?', or 'which AI bots can crawl my site?'. One robots.txt request; optional probe adds one page request per path as the chosen crawler's user-agent, and probeUserAgent lets you test a specific (or forged) UA.

crawlers.description: Optional robots tokens or agent names (default: every directory entry). Unknown names are reported as unmatched.

paths.description: Optional extra paths on the same origin as url, evaluated against the same robots.txt rules (no extra request).

probe.description: Optional. With exactly one crawler, also request the page as that crawler's user-agent to detect CDN/WAF blocks. With paths, each path is probed once.

probeUserAgent.description: Optional custom User-Agent for the probe (requires probe=true), e.g. a forged crawler string found in logs.

url.description: Public http(s) URL; only its origin's robots.txt is read

name: visdenda_check_crawler_access
title: Check robots.txt access for AI crawlers
